title: Counting on
description: Count from zero to fourteen without stopping.
grammar: the numbers from zero to fourteen
grammarNote: Every number has one form, and it never changes for gender.

explanation.summary: Unit 5 taught the shape of Spanish numbers. This unit fills in the ones it skipped: zero, and four through fourteen. After it there is no small number you cannot say.

sections.heading: Zero and four to nine
sections.body: Cero is nothing at all. Cuatro, seis, siete, ocho and nueve work exactly like the numbers you know: they go in front of the noun and never change. Cinco was in unit 5; these sit on either side of it.

sections.heading: Eleven to fourteen
sections.body: Once, doce, trece and catorce are each one word, like the tens. Diez was in unit 5 and quince comes in the next unit; these four close the gap between them. Quince keeps its accent; the others need none.
